title: Vanishing transfer from the whole closed subtype
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and $q\geq0$. If $H^q(Y,G)=0$ for every abelian sheaf $G$ on the subtype $Y=\{x\in X\mid x\in X\}$ with its subspace topology [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], then $H^q(X,F)=0$ for every abelian sheaf $F$ on $X$. No Noetherian hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Let i:Y into X be the subtype inclusion and j:X into Y its continuous inverse. Define G=j_*F. Lemma [lem-sc-cohomology-closed-immersion-pushforward] applies to i, whose image is the whole closed space, giving H^q(Y,G) isomorphic to H^q(X,i_*G).

The continuous maps satisfy j followed by i equals the identity. The presheaf pushforward composition, equality and identity isomorphisms (Mathlib TopCat.Presheaf.Pushforward.comp, pushforwardEq, Pushforward.id) lift through fullyFaithfulSheafToPresheaf to i_*G isomorphic to F. Apply cohomologyPresheafFunctor.mapIso and evaluate at the terminal open. Transfer subsingletonness between the standard comparison Ext universe and the small statement universe using Mathlib CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.chgUniv (Ext/Basic.lean:540). This yields IsZero H^q(X,F).
